ops.text: For instance, length-scaled eviction such as AlloKV Sadowska et al. (2026), which derives the number of retained tokens from the prompt length instead of keeping a fixed share of it, could enter the pool as further token-eviction settings next to the H2O ones.

new_bib.text: I. Sadowska, F. Mowat, T. Wierzbicki, and K. Ballantyne (2026). How much cache does a longer prompt need? Allometric budgets for KV-cache eviction.
